plugin.name: Marionette
plugin.description: Use when designing or building websites and landing pages, searching UI/UX and accessibility guidance, creating or updating Figma designs, specifying UI motion or implementing GSAP ScrollTrigger and CSS scroll animations, creating, editing or converting Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF Office files with GenOffice, coordinating multi-slice software specs or handing work over between sessions, authoring and fact-checking interactive HTML explainers, or doing research work; finding and reading papers, keeping a paper wiki, making paper diagrams and plots, planning experiments and pitching results without overclaiming, or reviewing and steering what TokenEconomizer learns and saves in agent sessions.

intake.goal: Extract art direction, layout, typography, palette and anti-slop checks; do not download photos, fonts or other external assets.
Extract motion principles, timing, easing, choreography and accessibility constraints; do not include unrelated GSAP library implementation.

runtime_deps.name: gsap
runtime_deps.license: GSAP Standard License (target project dependency, not bundled by Muro)

intake.goal: Extract ScrollTrigger implementation and cleanup patterns, respecting reduced motion; do not misstate GSAP's runtime license.
Extract the local work-map protocol, decision handoffs and evaluation gates; extend it through build and review without remote trackers.

runtime_deps.name: Figma MCP and figma-use
runtime_deps.license: External host integration, not bundled by Muro

intake.goal: Understand conversion strategy, content states and Figma token, component and responsive methods from the selected skills. Compare their functional responsibilities with the existing catalog and justify merges, separate stages or alternatives from source evidence; do not preassign the destination by name or source order. Do not simulate Figma MCP or include unrelated installation workflows.

runtime_deps.name: Python 3.10+ (standard library)
runtime_deps.license: PSF runtime prerequisite, not bundled by Muro

intake.goal: Understand local design-system search, stack-specific UX and accessibility guidance, and assess their functional relationship with the existing catalog before proposing placement. Preserve the offline search script and data without premium assets, install flows or unverified recommendations; search results are candidates for AI judgment, not automatic catalog decisions.

runtime_deps.name: GenOffice desktop app with its genoffice command line
runtime_deps.license: Apache-2.0 (external application, not bundled by Muro; installed at runtime from the official releases when missing)

intake.goal: Classify every outcome of the genoffice command-line skill (new decks, workbooks, Word and PDF documents, edits to existing files, conversion, extraction, editor handoff) into Office capabilities with their own checks. Keep the CLI an external user-installed dependency, mark the provider-backed search, image and media commands as data leaving the machine, and drop the skill, MCP and CLI installation or registration flows. The enterprise-licensed ee/ tree and the separate recommended scenario skills are out of scope.

Classify every outcome of the three skills: an interactive single-file HTML explainer built from documents, from topic research or from a codebase, and the claim-by-claim fact-check of an explainer. Keep the article template and the references as packaged helpers, keep the zero-dependency rule and the blocking fact-check gate, and drop the plugin manifests, host agent files, evals and upstream planning documents.

runtime_deps.name: uv, or Python 3.11+ (standard library; optional truststore)
runtime_deps.license: External runtime, not bundled by Muro; installed at runtime from astral.sh when missing and wanted

runtime_deps.license: MIT (third-party viewer libraries, not bundled by Muro; fetched at runtime from the jsDelivr npm mirror)

runtime_deps.name: PaperBananaBench reference dataset
runtime_deps.license: Apache-2.0 (about 266 MB, not bundled by Muro; downloaded at runtime from Hugging Face)

runtime_deps.name: matplotlib, numpy, pillow
runtime_deps.license: Their own open-source licences (target environment packages, not bundled by Muro)

runtime_deps.name: draw.io desktop command line
runtime_deps.license: Apache-2.0 (external application, not bundled by Muro)

intake.goal: Classify every outcome of the author's own research skills that stand on their own: literature search and paper reading with per-source switches, the OKF paper wiki with its viewer and validator, publication diagrams and plots (the two figure skills as one method), research-practice guidance, honest research communication, and the cross-session HANDOFF.md. Keep the scripts, references and style guides as packaged helpers. Leave out collected-skills (other authors' work), the third-party essays under research-bible/references, the vendored viewer libraries (fetched at runtime), and the skills that operate the author's own Research OS or repeat a need another source already serves.

runtime_deps.license: PSF runtime prerequisite, not bundled by Muro

runtime_deps.name: The user's own agent command line (claude, codex, copilot or pi) for the loop guard's judge and the fact proposer
runtime_deps.license: External host application, not bundled by Muro; called only by hooks the user registered

intake.goal: Absorb TokenEconomizer's control surface and engine: the status, micro-skills, tool-pruning, settings and repository-state commands as one capability, with the engine packaged unchanged so those commands run from this plugin. Catalog its six default hooks as passive, host-approved entries and make registering or removing them an explicit user-requested action that first discloses their effects. Leave out the upstream plugin manifests, slash commands and skills as files, the Pi extension, experiments and tests.
